description: pnpm 11 refuses a lockfile entry younger than a day, so anything that lands faster than that fails `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` in CI until the version ages out. Three days keeps a margin over that and over a weekend of nobody looking.

Renovate does not apply this to lockFileMaintenance, lockfileUpdate, pin or replacement updates -- the package manager resolves those itself -- so a lock file maintenance run can still produce an entry pnpm will reject.

packageRules.description: The artifact actions stay on v4. From v7 and v8 they bundle an artifact client that refuses to talk to anything but github.com, and Gitea reads to it as a GHES instance, so every job uploading coverage fails after its tests have already passed. Digest updates within v4 are still wanted.
